description:
Implementation plan for PR #847 on feat/whatsapp-main, requested by Jad in this conversation on 2026-10-19. Planning and issue creation only in this turn. Baseline ZAQ HEAD 37db92d1a; inspect ../jido_chat_whatsapp on feat/whatsapp-adapter-lifecycle-and-message-contracts (clean at planning). Main quote commit is 1edb1c349, which also contains reaction changes that MUST stay.

Target contract: for a WhatsApp reply, map the immediate quoted message ID to Incoming.external_thread_id and channel_meta.external_thread_id; non-replies retain nil. Use existing ZAQ thread/history machinery. A replies-to B chain does not recursively resolve a common ancestor: B replying to A uses A; C replying to B uses B. No synthetic root registry, inline prompt quote, quote hydration, or provider fetch is added. Missing originals remain absent. Direct-message history remains governed by existing Direct strategy (one chat history, ignores thread partition); Shared group history uses thread + bounded parent + matching root. Do not promise identical DM/group original availability.

Audit: Message.incoming_attrs currently sets external_thread_id nil and builds reply_context; Adapter event envelopes use only room thread key. JidoChatBridge already maps external_thread_id to ZAQ Incoming.thread_id. TranscriptHistory.capture and ExecutionHistory.parent_context already resolve/create scopes and load authorized stored roots. Adapter fetch_message/fetch_messages are unsupported. Chat.Thread.post passes :thread_id, while WhatsApp SendOptions accepts :quoted; preserve current outbound transport quoting and delivery, do not pretend incoming IDs implement outbound quote support.

Scope: remove all inline-reply additions from this PR across ZAQ ingress, persistence, retrieval, formatting and follow-up paths; update adapter normalization/event routing, dependency integration and tests. No wholesale revert of 1edb1c349 or dependency rollback: preserve tones/reactions, identity, media, pairing and Markdown changes. Do not remove shared Jido core fields from another repository: ZAQ/WhatsApp cease consuming/emitting them, while unrelated core consumers remain compatible. Ignore old stored quote metadata; no destructive historical-data migration.

Existing work: supersedes inline-quote direction in zaq-6zd/.1/.2. zaq-vl9/.1/.2 describes quote-media work and must not be reapplied; inspect live branch before removal because tracking includes work outside this branch. Record supersession without marking unlanded work completed.

Test behavior scope disclosed: remove/replace quote-specific assertions in ZAQ quoted_reply_test, input_prompt/pipeline/executor/request_control/history_ingress and linked_device runtime tests; sibling message/normalization tests replace inline quote/nil-thread expectations with immediate-target thread IDs. Preserve all unrelated author, mention, media, scope and delivery assertions. User explicitly requested removal of this feature and replacement with thread-based coverage; any additional existing-test behavior changes need approval under the testing handbook.

Action reuse: reuse existing Incoming constructor, bridge mapping, TranscriptHistory capture/list, ExecutionHistory projection, HistoryLoader, Executor/Factory and RequestControl lifecycle. Extend only adapter normalization/event identity. Pure formatting cleanup is local-only, no independent Action. Registry accounts.fetch_history is explicit recall, not automatic ingress enrichment; unsupported provider fetch is out of scope. No new Action/tool exposure, network call, state store or permissions bypass.

Acceptance: no quote fields or append_reply_context in ZAQ active code/docs; adapter emits thread target consistently; captured accessible group root reaches agent through history exactly once; missing/deleted/denied root never causes cross-scope fallback/fetch; cold/warm/follow-up, DM/group, duplicate and attachment behavior covered. Nested direct-target semantics are explicit. Existing data remains readable and non-reply/native-thread providers unchanged.

Sequence: cleanup -> adapter -> integration -> final review/coverage/validation. No new UI; backend integration tests required, no new browser feature E2E planned. Final validation follows repository gates and adapter AGENTS.md.
Policies: read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and the applicable Channels/Engine/Agent service sections before implementation; sibling adapter has its own AGENTS.md. Read module docs before edits. No commit/push authorization. Preserve unrelated branch changes.
